The India Story Teaser Released, Featuring Kajal Aggarwal and Shreyas Talpade

The teaser for the upcoming film 'The India Story: Slow Poison,' starring Kajal Aggarwal and Shreyas Talpade, has been released. The film appears to address the issue of pesticides, with the teaser showing Kajal Aggarwal in court against pesticides. Outlets highlight the film's potential to raise important questions about the presence of poison in food.
